svg.aria-label: Banners: Your icon, a small line, a title and a subtitle on top of every Markdown file.; Section icons: A colored tile with a white glyph in front of each heading.; Pictures: Grids, terminals, flows, layers, chips, buttons and slideshows from JSON.; Light and dark: Every picture twice, so GitHub shows the one that fits the reader.; No dependencies: Python's standard library and console-look, nothing else.; Accessible: Every picture carries its words for screen readers.
